findings.issue: Task 10 has wave: 4 and depends_on: [9], but Task 9 also has wave: 4. A task with depends_on:[X] must have wave > wave of task X. Tech-spec puts both in 'Final Wave' but they have a sequential dependency (Pre-deploy QA must finish before Deploy). Same wave with sequential dependency creates a deadlock for parallel execution and violates dependency-correctness invariant.
findings.fix: Set Task 10 wave to 5 (and Task 11 wave to 6 if applicable). Update tech-spec Implementation Tasks section to split 'Final Wave' into separate waves: Wave 4 (Pre-deploy QA), Wave 5 (Deploy), Wave 6 (Post-deploy verification).

findings.issue: Three project-knowledge paths are broken — files do not exist at the linked locations. Task 7 references `../../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/project.md`, `.../architecture.md`, `.../patterns.md` but these files live under `references/` subdirectory: `../../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/project.md` (etc.). Verified by listing the PK directory: top level only contains SKILL.md and references/. Same task correctly links deployment.md with `references/` segment, so the inconsistency is a typo/copy-paste error.
findings.fix: Replace the three broken links with correct paths that include `references/` segment: `../../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/project.md`, `.../references/architecture.md`, `.../references/patterns.md`.

findings.issue: Three project-knowledge paths use only `../../` (2 levels up), which from `work/publish-idempotency-fix/tasks/10.md` resolves to `work/.claude/...` — that directory does not exist. Correct relative path from a task file to repo-root `.claude/` is `../../../` (3 levels up). Affected lines: `[project.md](../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/project.md)`, `[architecture.md](../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/architecture.md)`, `[deployment.md](../../.claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/deployment.md)`.
findings.fix: Replace `../../.claude/...` with `../../../.claude/...` for all three PK links in Task 10's Context Files.

Verification Steps section contains both `### Smoke` (gh run list checks) and `### User` (operator confirmations on test channel and SQL DELETE result). Per template, `verify` field should reflect the verification subsections present in the body.
findings.fix: Set `verify: [smoke, user]` in frontmatter to match the Smoke + User subsections actually present.

findings.issue: Frontmatter `verify: []` but body contains `### Smoke` subsection with concrete checks (file exists, contains decision sections, verdict unambiguous). Inconsistency between frontmatter and body.
findings.fix: Either set `verify: [smoke]` in frontmatter to reflect the Smoke subsection, or relabel the smoke checks as part of Acceptance Criteria / Automated and remove the `### Smoke` heading. Smoke subsection content here describes deliverable presence (file exists), which is more an AC than a smoke check — choose one representation.
